title: Player season-long projections
description: Per-player point projection by position. Keyed on nflverse gsis_id. Produced by scripts/models/player_projection.py, validated by scripts/validate_data.py.

updated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last regeneration.

proj_points.description: Projected season fantasy points (baseline + earned signal weight).

low.description: Lower bound of the projection interval.

high.description: Upper bound of the projection interval.

signals_used.description: Names of signals that contributed non-zero weight to this projection.

rookie.description: nflverse roster years_exp == 0, joined by canonical name. ABSENT when nflverse was unreachable or the name was ambiguous - unknown is never false (R41).

baseline_rule.description: R49 - which baseline proj_points was built on (the candidate's games-normalized rule under the owner override; see meta.projection_baseline.shipped).

shipped_estimate.description: R49 OWNER OVERRIDE - which estimate proj_points/low/high are: 'candidate' (the scenario candidate; gated_* carries the gate-conforming number) or 'gated'. ABSENT on an older pool = gated.

gated_points.description: R49 - the gate-conforming projection (prior_season_points x adopted weights): the never-regress incumbent the ledger scores beside the candidate. Equals proj_points when shipped_estimate is 'gated'.

gated_rule.description: R49 - the baseline rule behind gated_points (the total rule until the walk-forward gate flips it).

prior_games.description: R49 - games played in the most recent prior season (ESPN statId 210 == player_history seasons.games). null = unknown, never 17.

prior_ppg.description: R49 - recency-weighted (2:1) PPR points per game played over the last two prior seasons. null when no game count is known.

projected_games.description: R49 - 17 minus absence_weeks. null when prior_ppg is unknown.

absence_weeks.description: R49 - DOCUMENTED expected absence from data/injuries.json (a stated duration, out-for-season, or the 4-game IR/PUP/NFI floor; build_weekly.blocked_week_count). 0 when nothing is documented - unknown is not a discount.

candidate_baseline.description: CANDIDATE (not adopted, backtested): prior_ppg x projected_games, or the shipped baseline when the per-game rate is unknown.

candidate_points.description: CANDIDATE (not adopted, backtested): candidate_baseline x every raw signal adjustment in candidate_signals applied at full strength (weight 1). The owner's scenario estimate; scored by the estimate ledger against actuals. NEVER a ranking input while its signals carry weight 0.

candidate_low.description: CANDIDATE: candidate_points x (1 - band), band = the position-volatility + player-uncertainty interval half-width (one-sd rule, an estimate of spread, not a measurement).

candidate_signals.description: CANDIDATE: {signal name: raw multiplicative adjustment} - every factor behind candidate_points, so each move is auditable. Only signals whose inputs the feeds actually carried appear; absent = not computable, never 1.0 by assumption.
